meta.title: Tafrikt d yisem-is
meta.desc: Afri, Africa, Ifriqiya : amek i yuɣal yisem n tmurt n Qarṭaǧ, Tunisia n wassa, d isem n umurig meṛṛa.
hero.lede: I Iṛumaniyen, Africa yebɣa ad yini ɣef tmanaḏt i d-yettwasersen deg 146 send Ɛisa ɣef tmurt n Qarṭaǧ — ugafa agmaṛ n Tunisia n wassa. Isem-agi yettimɣur, deg sin iṭalaf iseggasen, armi d umurig meṛṛa.
hero.caption: Asinag agraɣlan n Bardo, Tunes
theories.title: Seg wanda i d-yekka « Afri » ?
theories.aside: Kuẓ tiktiwin i d-yettwasresen. Ulac yiwet yettwaseknen ; tamezwarut i yettwaqeblen aṭas.
theories.items.0.text: Ifri (neɣ Aourigha), agdud amaziɣ i yezgan qrib Qarṭaǧ. Awal amaziɣ ifri yebɣa ad yini imezdaɣ n tɣerman.
theories.items.0.detail: Iṛumaniyen semɣuṛen ahat isem n yimezdaɣ-agi iqeṛben ɣer Qarṭaǧ ɣer tmanaḏt meṛṛa.
theories.items.1.text: Deg tutlayt n Qarṭaǧ, ʿafar yebɣa ad yini « aɣubbaṛ » neɣ « akal » : Africa tezmer ad tili kan « tamurt ».
theories.items.1.detail: Azwel n wawal i d-yettwalin ɣer igrudan iwerɣen n daxel n Tunisia.
theories.items.2.text: Awal alatini aprica, « ițwaqabel i yiṭij », i d-yefka s telqey Isidore n Séville iwakken ad yesseḍheṛ sebba n sshana n tmurt-agi.
theories.items.2.detail: Teḥlu, maca ass-a ttwalin deg-s azwel n wawal n ugdud kan.
theories.items.3.text: Seg wawal agrikan a-phrikē, « war asemmiḏ » : tamurt tesseɣ, mgal zzman n Tagrikt.
theories.items.3.detail: Yettwabder sɣur Léon Afrikan deg lqern wis 16 ; drus n yimusnawen i t-yeqeblen.
journey.title: Tikli n yisem
journey.aside: Seg wagdud amasay armi d umurig n 54 n tmura.
journey.steps.0.title: Tamurt n Ifri
journey.steps.0.text: Agdud amasay, mačči umurig. Imiṣriyen semman i Ilibikiyen n ugmur Tehenou akked Temehou.
journey.steps.1.title: Asers n Qarṭaǧ
journey.steps.1.text: Iṣuriyen rsen deg tmurt talibikit. Igrikiyen semman i tmanaḏt meṛṛa « Libya ».
journey.steps.2.title: Imenɣan ipunikiyen
journey.steps.2.text: S umsagar akked Qarṭaǧ, Iṛumaniyen semman i yimezdaɣ Afer (deg tugget Afri).
journey.steps.3.title: Tamanaḏt n Africa
journey.steps.3.text: Mbeɛd ahelak n Qarṭaǧ, Ṛuma tesres tamanaḏt n Africa : aseqdec amagnu amezwaru n yisem.
journey.steps.4.title: Tamɣurt n yisem
journey.steps.4.text: Pline Amɣar akked Pomponius Mela seqdacen Africa i umurig meṛṛa yettwassnen, mgar seg Africa s telqey.
journey.steps.5.title: Ifriqiya
journey.steps.5.text: Imnekcamen iɛraben ṭṭfen isem alatini i Tunisia d yiḥricen-is, s Kairouan d taneddawt.
journey.steps.6.name: Afrique
journey.steps.6.title: Umurig meṛṛa
journey.steps.6.text: Akked tirzan timeqqranin n lebḥer, imgezzamen n takarṭa semɣuṛen isem armi d Ucenfiṛ n Usirem Ilhan.
ifr.title: Isem ur yettwattun ara
ifr.text: « Ifriqiya » (إفريقية) d asuɣel usrid n Africa n latinit. Yettwaseqdac deg lweqt n leqrun agensan i Tunisia, akked usamer n Lezzayer n wassa d Tripolitaine, yesken-d belli isem werǧin yeffeɣ tamanaḏt-agi. Deg wannect-nni, Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is, yettwasers sɣur Ṛuma, tuɣal d taneddawt n Africa taṛumanit.
ifr.more: Wali daɣen : Qarṭaǧ tedder di Tunisia →
ifr.caption: Kairouan, yettwasers deg 670, taneddawt n Ifriqiya
peoples.title: Tafrikt n ugafa uqbel Qarṭaǧ
peoples.aside: Igduden i yezwaren, yesṭerḥben, yezgan akked Ifiniqiyen.
peoples.items.0.name: Ikapsiyen
peoples.items.0.text: Tagemmi taqdimt yettwasemman s Gafsa (Capsa), di Tunisia. Ahat d imezwura n Imaziɣen, ǧǧan-d aṭas n yimukan isenfarrutanen.
peoples.items.1.name: Imaziɣen
peoples.items.1.text: Agdud n lqaɛa n Lmaɣrib seg iṭalaf iseggasen, imezwura n Imaziɣen n wassa. Lḥuḍur-nsen yettwasekn s taẓuri taɛraft n yedɣaɣen.
peoples.items.2.name: Tigeldiwin tinumidiyin
peoples.items.2.text: Ineggafen iɛeggalen n Lezzayer n wassa d umalu n Tunisia. Masinisa yeẓẓa cci deg tagara n umenɣi apunik wis sin ; ineggafen inumidiyen ɛawanen Qarṭaǧ, imbeɛd Ṛuma.
peoples.items.3.name: Igaramantiyen
peoples.items.3.text: Di Fezzan (Libya), tagemmi tezga deg Ssaḥra s telqey i tɣaltin n wasway ddaw n tmurt (foggaras), deg ul n ttjara n Ssaḥra.
identity.title: Asegmi afrikan n Qarṭaǧ
identity.alt: Takatut i d-yettwassnen « Tamɣart n Qarṭaǧ »
identity.caption: « Tamɣart n Qarṭaǧ », takatut, asinag n Qarṭaǧ
identity.items.0.title: Asemdiweg n yidlisen
identity.items.0.text: Tirawin tifiniqiyin akked tgemmiyin tilibikiyin-timaziɣin msedwayent ; zzwaǧat gar igdawen ddukklen aṭas. Tagemmi tapunit i d-ițlalen d tagemmi tafrikant s telqey.
identity.items.1.title: Ddin
identity.items.1.text: Baal Hammon akked Tanit, d-kkan seg Tefniqt, ṭṭfen di Qarṭaǧ amḍiq akked tiliɣa timaynutin ; aḍfar n yimahlen ilibikiyen mazal-it yettwasmeyya.
identity.items.2.title: Tutlayt tapunit
identity.items.2.text: Tekka-d seg tefiniqit, tapunikt mazal-itt tettwameslay deg Tafrikt n ugafa armi d lqern wis 5 mbeɛd Ɛisa, akken i d-yeqqar Augustin.
identity.items.3.title: Aɣerbaz
identity.items.3.text: Appien yeḥka-d, qrib Byrsa, ixxamen n sețța iḥedrayen ; aɣerbaz apuni yesnjam i wemḍiq akked usegnaf afrikan.
identity.items.4.title: Aɛesskar n igdawen
identity.items.4.text: Ilibikiyen, Inumidiyen, Imeṛṛa nnuɣen akked Iberiyen, wid n Jzayer Baléares d Igaliyen : aɛesskar-agi yesken-d asegmi afrikan n Qarṭaǧ.
identity.items.5.title: Tamusni tafellaḥt
identity.items.5.text: Tamusni tafiniqit akked tamusni tamasayt n wakal fkant-d yiwet seg tfellaḥin yesɛan aṭas n lɣella deg ddunit taqdimt.
mixed.title: Tagemmi yemsedwayen
mixed.aside: Idles d-yekkan seg Ccerq, iẓaṛ deg Tafrikt, yeldi ɣer Tagrikt akked Maṣer : Qarṭaǧ d amagar n yiberdan.
mixed.items.0.title: Izuran ikanaɛaniyen
mixed.items.0.paras.0: Tagemmi tafiniqit tekka-d seg ddunit n Kanaɛan mbeɛd leɛwayed n « Igduden n lebḥer », azal n 1200 send Ɛisa. Teṭṭef zik aṭas ismal timiṣriyin, imbeɛd tigrikiyin. Qarṭaǧ tewrit asemdiweg-agi tawi-t ɣer ugmur.
mixed.items.0.paras.1: Akken i d-yeqqar Augustin, iqeddacen n Tafrikt qqaren-d mazal-iten « Chanani », Ikanaɛaniyen, ugar n xemsa iqrunen mbeɛd 146. Acehhed-agi yettwasmeyya : Josephine Quinn tettwali deg-s tarrayt n wawal, Gabriel Camps yettwali deg-s tutlayt talibikit, apunikus akka yebɣa ad yini aṭas n tikwal « afrikan ».
mixed.items.1.title: Lecɣal n snat n tgemmiyin
mixed.items.1.paras.0: Ucenfiṛen imeẓyanen n djaǧ ttwasersen deg yimḍalen iwakken ad sfeḍen leǥnun, lemtel n ulutus : Maṣer dinna meṛṛa. Seg lqern wis 4 send Ɛisa, ismal igrikiyen ddukklen fell-as.
mixed.items.1.paras.1: Aqcic n Motyé, azru n lqern wis 5 i d-yettwafen deg 1979, yessken tamsalt : Melqart ihellanen, lǥerḥ n umenɣi agrikan, neɣ asutel apunik i umgezzam n Sicile ? I Serge Lancel, Qarṭaǧ tella d amḍiq n umsagar, teldi aṭas ɣer wayen i d-yekkan seg berra.
mixed.items.2.title: Alibiki d upunik msedwayen
mixed.items.2.paras.0: Azekka alibiko-apunik n Dougga (lqern wis 2 send Ɛisa) yesdukkel ismal timiṣriyin d wayen d-yekkan seg Tagrikt ɣef tmurt tinumidit. Ɣer El Hofra, qrib Cirta (Constantine), amḍiq aqeddas aneggaru apunik ameqqran akteṛ i yettwakecfen yesdukkel ismal ilibikiyen d yipuniyen.
mixed.items.2.paras.1: Deg timdinin n Tafrikt taṛumanit, sufeṭ llant kra n tikwal krad deg umkan n snat : kra n yimusnawen ttwalin deg-s ayen d-yekkan seg Imaziɣen.
mixed.items.3.title: Asegmi i yeqqimen ddren
mixed.items.3.paras.0: Sufeṭ sɣaṛen mazal-iten timdinin n Tafrikt taṛumanit deg lqern wis 2 mbeɛd Ɛisa. Opus africanum n Kerkouane yettwaf deg Capitole n Dougga. Baal Hammon yuɣal d Saturne afrikan, yettwaqdar armi d lqern wis 4, Tanit tuɣal d Caelestis n Iṛumaniyen (Marcel Le Glay).
mixed.items.3.paras.1: Akken i d-yeqqar Pline (XVIII, 22), idlisen n texxamin n tira n Qarṭaǧ ttunefkent i igelliden inumidiyen. I Stéphane Gsell imbeɛd M. H. Fantar, tudert n tutlayt tasamit tezmer ad tefk afus, aṭas mbeɛd, i taɛrabt n Lmaɣrib.
dna.kicker: Tamusni n ddem akked umezruy n yiwdan
dna.title: Ayen i d-yeqqar ADN aqdim
dna.lede: Seg mraw iseggasen aya, ADN aqdim yesseqsay ɣef yimezwura n yimezdaɣ n umaḏal apunik. Igmaḏ, bennun ɣef kra n sserdasat, snernin tasekkant n wagdud i d-yusan s lekter seg Ccerq.
dna.rows.0.title: Aqcic n Byrsa.
dna.rows.0.text: Yettwamḍal deg tagara n lqern wis 6 send Ɛisa, yettwaf ɣef tiɣilt n Byrsa, yesɛa ADN n lmitukundriyat (asel n yemma) n uhaplugrup idris U5b2c1, i d-yekkan seg Turuft (Matisoo-Smith et al.). Yiwen kan n wemdan : asekken n usemdiweg azwaray, mačči tugna n wagdud.
dna.rows.1.title: Hispanya, Ibiza, Sardaigne.
dna.rows.1.text: Aṭas n tezrawin (Olalde, Marcus, Sarno, De Angelis) sbeggnent-d izuran n ugafa n Tafrikt deg yimdanen ipuniyen : seg 20 ɣer 35 % di Villamar, di Sardaigne, mgal drus aṭas di Monte Sirai, yettwasersen zik sɣur Ifiniqiyen ; amdan n uẓekka apuni n Ibiza (361–178 send Ɛisa) yemfaṛaq s telqey seg wid-nniḍen n Jzayer Baléares.
dna.rows.2.title: Kerkouane.
dna.rows.2.text: Sin ɛecra n yimdanen i yettwasnan (Moots et al.) msemgaraden aṭas : sebɛa qṛiben ɣer Isiciliyen n zzman n ubruz, kuẓ deffir n ifellaḥen inuliṭiyen n Lmaɣrib, yiwen qṛib ɣer Imeṛṛakiyen d Imuzabiyen n wassa. Ulac izuran icerqiyen ibanen : imeskaren bedren asserɣ n yimaẓlaḥ imezwura neɣ amḍan-nsen idrusen.
dna.rows.3.title: Sin meyya n ADN.
dna.rows.3.text: Tazrawt n usinag n Max-Planck akked Harvard (Ringbauer et al., Nature) tekka ɣef azal n 200 n yimdanen seg 14 n yimukan. Qrib ulac izuran icerqiyen : Ipuniyen d-kkan s telqey seg yimezdaɣ qṛiben ɣer Sicile akked Igée, aṭas seg wayen i d-yeqqimen yekka-d seg Tafrikt n ugafa. Di Qarṭaǧ, 14 seg 17 n yimdanen sɛan drus seg 15 % n izuran n ugafa n Tafrikt, krad-nniḍen ger 20 d 50 %.
dna.sum.0: Tagemmi tafiniqit tezger s ttjara, umsagar d usedwi, mačči s tikli tamagnut n wagdud.
dna.sum.1: Imezdaɣ n ugafa n Tafrikt fkan afus ameqqran deg timdinin tipuniyen, s lmeqyas yemxallafen seg wemḍiq ɣer wayeḍ.
dna.sum.2: Lḥader : drus n yimdanen deg yal amḍiq, aserɣ i yellan deg leqrun imezwura yekkes seg yimusnawen n ddem imaẓlaḥ imezwura.
dna.sum.3: ADN ur d-yeqqar ara tutlayt, ne ddin, ne asegmi : Iqarṭaǧiyen țmeslayen tafiniqit, qeddcen iyilluten n Ṣur.
dna.anth.0.val: Talɣa n tuɣmas n Iqarṭaǧiyen tqeṛṛeb-iten ɣer yimezdaɣ n ugafa n Tafrikt, s telqey ɣer Iguanciyen n Jzayer Tikanariyin (Guatelli-Steinberg, Irish, Lukacs).
dna.anth.1.val: Tazrawt n M.-C. Chamla akked D. Ferembach, yuɣal fell-as S. O. Y. Keita, tqeṛṛeb tarbaɛt taqarṭaǧit ɣer Lezzayriyen n zzman aqdim, imbeɛd ɣer Iṛumaniyen n Tarragone.
dna.anth.2.val: I Keita, sin ɛecra n yiqerra iqarṭaǧiyen i d-yezwaren Hanibal ttwasersen ger tarbaɛt tafiniqit d tin n Lmaɣrib, qṛiben ugar ɣer tagi : tasekkant n usemdiweg.
legacy.title: Lwert aqarṭaǧi di Tafrikt
legacy.aside: Ayen i d-tǧǧa Qarṭaǧ i umurig.
legacy.items.0.title: Isem n umurig
legacy.items.0.text: Lwert yeqqimen aṭas : isem s yiman-is n Tafrikt yekka-d seg tmurt anida tebna temdint tapunit.
legacy.items.0.items.1: Seg Tunisia ɣer umurig meṛṛa deg 2000 n iseggasen
legacy.items.0.items.2: Tugget n tutlayin n ddunit seqdacent talɣa i d-yekkan seg-s
legacy.items.1.title: Tirza tafrikant
legacy.items.1.text: Iqarṭaǧiyen ttwalin seg ibidaɣen imezwura n ugaraw n Turuft n Tafrikt.
legacy.items.1.items.0: Hanun yeddu ɣef rrif agmaṛ n Tafrikt (azal n 500 send Ɛisa)
legacy.items.1.items.1: Ahat yewweḍ ɣer ucenfiṛ n Guinée — tilisa mazal-itt tettwasmeyya
legacy.items.1.items.2: Tiklarit-ines d taqsist tiqdimt akteṛ n tirza n ugmaṛ n Tafrikt
legacy.items.2.title: Aɣerbaz n ugafa n Tafrikt
legacy.items.2.alt: Kerkouane, tamdint tapunit n Ras Addar
legacy.items.2.text: Qarṭaǧ tesres lqwaɛed n temdint di Tafrikt n ugafa ; Kerkouane, ɣef Ras Addar, d acehhed ilhan akteṛ.
legacy.items.2.items.0: Azeṭṭa n timdinin tipuniyen seg Tunisia armi d Marok
legacy.items.2.items.1: Lemtel aɣerbaz i ṭṭfen Iṛumaniyen imbeɛd Iɛraben
legacy.items.2.items.2: Tirrayin n ubennu yesnjamen i usegnaf
legacy.items.3.title: Tafellaḥt
legacy.items.3.text: Tirrayin tiqarṭaǧiyin bedlent tiẓgi n ugafa n Tafrikt.
legacy.items.3.items.2: Adlis n Magun, yettwasuɣlen ɣer tlatinit s lameṛ n Ssenaṭ, yesnjam tafellaḥt taṛumanit
facts.title: Tessnem ?
facts.items.0.title: Augustin d tapunikt
facts.items.0.text: Augustin n Hippone (354–430), Amaziɣ yettwaṛumi, yeqqar-d belli tapunikt mazal-itt tettwameslay deg tuddar — ugar n 500 n iseggasen mbeɛd aɣelli n Qarṭaǧ.
facts.items.1.title: Tiklarit n Hanun
facts.items.1.text: Azal n 500 send Ɛisa, 60 n lbabura akked 30 000 n imaẓlaḥ ɣef rrif n ugaraw n Turuft. Taqsist tḥekku-d « ilfan n lǥab » — ahat d imegdal neɣ ilfan n lǥab — akked wedrar yeččuren s times.
facts.items.2.title: Qarṭaǧ taṛumanit
facts.items.2.text: Yettwaḥudd sɣur César, asers-nni-nniḍen n Qarṭaǧ yettwakemmel ddaw n Auguste (29 send Ɛisa). Tamdint tuɣal d yiwet seg timdinin timeqqranin n Tagelda, taneddawt n Africa.
facts.items.3.title: Ifriqiya
facts.items.3.text: Awal aɛrab إفريقية, i d-yeqqaren ɣef Tunisia n leqrun agensan, d asuɣel usrid n Africa n latinit.
facts.items.4.title: Lwert agraɣlan
facts.items.4.text: Amḍiq n Qarṭaǧ, deg ugmur n Tunes, yettwajerred deg lwert agraɣlan n UNESCO seg 1979.
facts.items.5.title: Aɛeggal afrikan
facts.items.5.text: Hanibal, yilul-d di Qarṭaǧ, yeddu s uɛesskar afrikan s telqey mgal tezmert tigrikit tameqqrant n zzman-ines.
